s: Chatimat birkat hashiba ubo b' seipim: "hashiba shopetenu" chotem bah "melek oheb tzedaqa umishpat", mah sheen ken bishar berakot sheen malkut bachatimatan ella bemishpat bilbad, mishshum shenneemar: "melek bemishpat yaamid aretz". Umerosh hashshana ad yom kippur chotem "hammelek hammishpat", uperusho hu melek hammishpat, veken hu leshon hammiqra lipamim kemo "haaron habberit" vedomayv. Veim amar "melek oheb tzedaqa umishpat" — yitbaer besiman tqp"b:

Be"birkat hamminim" tzarik liklol gam ha"zedim", shenneemar: "vesheber posheim vechattaim yachdav veozebe Hashem yiklu", "ozebe Hashem" ellu hamminim sheenam maaminim bedat mosheh shehayeta min hashshamayim, u"posheim" ellu hazzedim, ki posheim ellu hammoredim, kemo shekkatub: "melek moab pasha bi". Ub"birkat hatztzaddiqim" tzarik liklol gam gere tzedeq, mishshum shenneemar: "mippene seba taqum vego'", uketib acharayv: "veki yagur itteka ger vego'", hare gerim semukim latztzaddiqim, lekak kolelam bibraka achat:
